title: Implement the independent verification runner and VerificationReport contract
objective: Implement an independent verification runner that evaluates a clean checkout of a candidate commit from outside the agent worktree and emits a complete VerificationReport 1.0. The runner is the sole accepted authority for deterministic verification results; agent self-reports are unverified-claim data and cannot satisfy a gate. The runner must fail closed when any required check, artifact, checkout, or invariant result is missing. Preserve the existing Phase 0–3 contracts and semantics and do not let the evaluated agent write the runner, CI definition, verification policy, or report after execution.
external_artifacts: /srv/projects/.tooling/progresstrace-verification/runner/ — runner source and immutable execution wrapper, managed outside the agent worktree
required_contract_decisions: VerificationReport 1.0 records the evaluated commit, clean-checkout identity, complete ordered check list, each check exit code and duration, overall status, command-set digest, evaluated-tree digest, and runner identity/version.

The required check set includes Release build with --warnaserror, all existing conformance phases, JSON Schema validity, benchmark 60/60 with byte-identical repeated output, dotnet format --verify-no-changes, git diff --check, and every invariant registered by Task 4.0.C.
A missing, partial, malformed, stale, or unverifiable report is failure; unknown is not success and cannot satisfy a gate.
The evaluated checkout is created independently from the agent worktree and is clean before execution; the runner and its policy are read-only to the evaluated agent.
Core verification commands have no network, database, model, or third-party runtime dependency behavior.
The report contains no untrusted payload echo beyond bounded safe identifiers and digests.
deliverables: VerificationReport 1.0 JSON Schema and normative documentation
Independent runner and clean-checkout execution wrapper outside the agent worktree
Immutable command-set and evaluated-tree digest calculation
Tests for missing checks, non-zero exits, stale commit, dirty checkout, malformed report, and byte-deterministic report serialization
Integration with the invariant runner from Task 4.0.C
README/CI documentation without granting the evaluated agent write access to runner or policy
Self-check evidence and external report manifest
non_goals: No automatic merge implementation in this task
No replacement of the existing CI definition by an agent-controlled file
No persistence or hosted verification service
No changes to existing Phase 0–3 contracts or benchmark semantics
stop_conditions: The evaluated agent can modify runner, policy, CI definition, or report inputs after verification begins
Any required check is absent, partial, unverifiable, or reported only by the evaluated agent
The runner requires network, model, database, or runtime dependency behavior in core verification
The external runner path is unavailable or not writable by the orchestrator where required
The allowed path set is exceeded
Two bounded repair attempts are exhausted
